units.summary: Adds a longRunning gauge vec to the metrics struct; the histogram gains a verb label. This changes the exported metric series shape.
units.headline: Router metrics gain long-running gauge and verb label
units.reason: Changes metric series and labels that dashboards and alerts may depend on.
focus: Existing dashboards or alerts using the histogram's labels, since a verb label was added
Label cardinality of the new verb label

units.summary: Watches are now counted in a long-running gauge and excluded from the histogram and in-flight gauge. The histogram gets a verb label, and watches are logged when they end.
units.headline: Instrument separates watches from ordinary request metrics
units.reason: Changes request-metric semantics and control flow in the request path.
focus: Watch gauge Inc/Dec pairing and the log on panic or abort
Verb label cardinality for non-resource paths (falls back to the lowercased HTTP method)
Whether the access log still records the status for watches

units.summary: Adds a router-wide context and cancel func used to end all watches on shutdown.
units.headline: Router gets context to end all watches
units.reason: Adds fields only; behavior is exercised in serveWatch and closeWatches.

units.summary: Upgrade requests to routed groups are now rejected with a 400. Watch requests are served through serveWatch, scoped to the entry's watch context.
units.headline: Routed requests reject upgrades and serve watches via serveWatch
units.reason: Changes request handling and rejects previously passed-through requests.
focus: rejectUpgrade runs before any other proxying, including non-watch upgrade requests
Watch cancellation when the entry is replaced

units.summary: The single-tenant fallback path now rejects upgrades and serves watches through serveWatch with only the router-wide scope.
units.headline: Unregistered-group fallback rejects upgrades and wraps watches
units.reason: Changes request handling for fallback traffic.
focus: Fallback traffic that relied on upgrades now gets a 400
A nil scope means watches end only on router close

units.summary: New helpers: verb detection through the apiserver RequestInfoFactory, upgrade rejection, and serveWatch. serveWatch cancels a watch when its scope or the router ends, and swallows ErrAbortHandler panics for router-initiated ends. closeWatches cancels the router-wide context.
units.headline: Adds watch lifecycle, verb detection and upgrade rejection
units.reason: New concurrency and panic-recovery logic in the request path.
focus: The recover condition that suppresses ErrAbortHandler only when the router canceled the watch
Verb detection for paths outside the resource API
Upgrade detection via the Connection header only
